## 2. Core Service Hubs & Technical Architecture

### A. Air-Gapped Local GPU LLM Quantization & MCP Legal Servers
- **Target URL:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/local-gpu-llm-quantization`
- **Technical Blueprint:** Deploys 70B parameter open-weights models (Qwen 2.5 72B, Llama 3.3 70B) compressed to 4-bit precision (AWQ, GGUF Q4_K_M) on dedicated physical workstation hardware (NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 48GB or dual RTX 4090).
- **Compliance Mandate:** 100% compliance with India's **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023** and advocate-client confidentiality privilege under the Indian Evidence Act. Zero outbound internet packets; zero cloud API data leakage.
- **Inference Benchmark:** 25.4 tokens/sec at 32k context length using vLLM PagedAttention. Connects to internal corporate legal archives via local Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers over stdio.

### B. Sub-300ms Conversational Voice AI Telephony & Indic Agents
- **Target URL:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/ai-voice-agents` & `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/multilingual-voice-ai-telephony`
- **Technical Blueprint:** Full-duplex conversational voice agents streaming 8kHz audio over WebSockets and SIP trunks (Exotel, Tata Tele, Twilio, Asterisk PBX).
- **Latency Benchmark:** <290ms end-to-end turn-taking latency. Utilizes Silero Voice Activity Detection (VAD) for instant 50ms user interruption, Sarvam Saarika Indic ASR (~180ms TTFT), token-piped local LLM, and Sarvam Bulbul neural TTS (~280ms TTFA) in Hindi, Punjabi, and English.

### C. Direct Meta Cloud API WhatsApp Business Automation (Zero SaaS Fees)
- **Target URL:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/whatsapp-business-bot`
- **Technical Blueprint:** Custom Node.js / Python webhook microservices connected straight to Meta's official WhatsApp Business Cloud API v20.0 without intermediary aggregators (WATI, AiSensy).
- **Cost Advantage:** ₹0 monthly platform subscription fees (saving ₹3,000–₹12,000/mo). Businesses receive Meta's 1,000 free monthly service conversations and pay only baseline carrier chat rates (~₹0.30 to ₹0.72 per chat).
- **12 Vertical WhatsApp Solutions:**
  - Jewelry Stores (`/services/whatsapp-bot-jewelry-stores`): Live MCX gold rate pricing, HUID hallmark verification, bridal lounge appointments.
  - Coaching Institutes (`/services/whatsapp-bot-coaching-institutes`): Exam syllabus PDFs, fee structure breakdowns, free trial seat reservations.
  - Clinics & Hospitals (`/services/whatsapp-bot-clinics-hospitals`): Doctor OPD token dispatch, queue notifications, zero PHI tracker leaks.
  - Salons & Spas (`/services/whatsapp-bot-salons-spas`): Stylist selection, 2-step automated no-show reduction reminders.
  - Real Estate (`/services/whatsapp-bot-real-estate`): Budget/BHK qualification, RERA Section 11(2) compliant PDF brochure watermarks.
  - Malls & Retail (`/services/whatsapp-bot-malls-retail`): Tenant floor directory fuzzy search, cinema schedules, parking tariffs.
  - Gyms & Fitness (`/services/whatsapp-bot-gyms-fitness`): Automated membership renewal sequences, direct UPI payment links, RFID turnstile activation.
  - Restaurants & Cafes (`/services/whatsapp-bot-restaurants-cafes`): Direct digital menus, table bookings, KOT thermal printer webhooks (bypassing 25-30% Swiggy/Zomato commissions).
  - Travel Agencies (`/services/whatsapp-bot-travel-agencies`): Day-wise holiday PDF itineraries, visa requirement checklists.
  - Wedding Planners (`/services/whatsapp-bot-wedding-planners`): Auspicious date availability, per-plate catering math, luxury decor portfolios.
  - Furniture Showrooms (`/services/whatsapp-bot-furniture-showrooms`): Room dimension filtering, solid wood specifications, VIP visit passes.
  - Automobile Dealerships (`/services/whatsapp-bot-automobile-dealerships`): Periodic service reminders, test-drive booking, insurance renewal quotes.

### D. Automated 1080p60 VideoGen Engine (Remotion + FFmpeg NVENC)
- **Target URL:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/automated-video-generation-engine`
- **Technical Blueprint:** Programmatic 1080p60 vertical (9:16) video creation pipeline. Compiles Remotion React compositions on local dedicated workstation GPUs using hardware-accelerated FFmpeg NVENC encoding.
- **Economic Advantage:** $0 cloud rendering bills (eliminating $0.15–$0.45/minute third-party SaaS fees). Renders at 8.4x real-time speed and auto-publishes to YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels via APIs.

### E. Offline Mobile ML Apps (Flutter + TensorFlow Lite)
- **Target URLs:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/offline-ai-app-development`, `https://www.gurdharam.com/case-studies/fasal-doctor`, `https://www.gurdharam.com/case-studies/doodhisaab`
- **Fasal Doctor:** On-device agritech computer vision app diagnosing 13+ crop diseases (wheat rust, cotton blight) in <1.4 seconds using an 11.2MB INT8 quantized MobileNetV2 model running in Flutter Isolates with zero 4G internet requirements.
- **DoodHisaab:** Phone-first rural milk collection and dairy accounting ledger app running on embedded local SQLite, automating daily morning/evening fat/SNF payout calculations with instant on-device PDF WhatsApp receipts.

### F. High-Performance Web Development & Technical SEO
- **Target URL:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/web-development` & `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/web-developer-muktsar-punjab`
- **Technical Blueprint:** Modern React Single Page Applications pre-rendered to pure static HTML via Vite build hooks (`prerender.js`). Sub-500ms First Contentful Paint, zero layout shifts (CLS 0.00), native 60 FPS Three.js WebGL digital twins with DRACO mesh compression.
